name: Imouto ni Doutei o Sute Sasete Moratta ~Tsundere Fuumi~
original_name: 妹に童貞を捨てさせてもらった～ツンデレ風味～
source:
"I'm begging you!
Take my virginity!
No... let me lose it to you!!"

One day brother went to his little sister's room to ask an unreasonable thing...

The story of a boy's first time.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE074112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我求你了！
夺走我的处女！
不……让我把第一次交给你！！”

一天，哥哥来到妹妹的房间，提出了一个无理的请求……

这是一个男孩第一次体验的故事。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE074112.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
